title.description: The lesson's title. At most 8 words.

summary.description: One sentence: what someone will understand after watching.

id.description: Stable id: s1, s2, ... Never reuse an id within a lesson.

heading.description: The scene's title on screen. At most 8 words.

subheading.description: One short line under the heading, or an empty string.

text.description: What appears on screen. Short: at most 9 words.

detail.description: A smaller second line, or an empty string.

at.description: Index of the narration sentence during which this item appears.

code.description: Code for the code layout; an empty string otherwise.

narration.description: What the voice says over this scene, written for the ear: 2 to 5 short sentences, plain words, numbers and symbols written the way they are said.
